recipes.name: Spinach Lasagna Rolls
ingredients_raw: 1 (10 ounce) package frozen chopped spinach, thawed, well drained
1.25 cups KRAFT Shredded Low-Moisture Whole Milk Mozzarella Cheese, divided

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).

Mix together spinach, 1 cup mozzarella cheese, cream cheese, and Parmesan cheese in a large bowl until well blended; spread onto noodles and roll up tightly. Place rolls, seam-side down, in a 9-inch square baking dish. Top with sauce and remaining 1/4 cup mozzarella.
Bake in the preheated oven until heated through, about 30 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Spinach Lasagna Rolls
raw_recipe.description: Spinach lasagna rolls are filled with Parmesan, mozzarella, and cream cheese. These flavorful rolls are topped with pasta sauce and more Parmesan cheese, then baked until hot and bubbly.

review.reviewBody:
So tasty! I liked that this was a lasagna recipe that didn't include ricotta (not my favourite kind of cheese). There are few enough ingredients here that most people people will have these all on hand. I didn't change a thing with the recipe and hubby loved it. No, he raved about it. This is now one of our favourites!

Just a quick update -- This is the 4th time I've made this dish, but I found a time-saver that really works great. Instead of using dry lasagna noodles and having to boil them, I bought oven-ready noodles (which are fresh noodles) and this cut down on the time needed to cook everything. I just rolled the filling into the noodles and popped it all into the oven. Excellent! Turned out better, too!

--- Another update (July 30 '10): Made this meal ahead of time and froze the lasagna rolls - it turned out excellent. I made the rolls as per my instructions above and froze them (without the sauce). When almost ready to use, I defrosted them in the fridge for a day and put them in a greased pan, poured the sauce over them and cooked for an hour at 350 degrees. Perfect. Will make these in batches and freeze for later use. Thanks again Philadelphia!!!

LOVE this recipe! I did make a couple of changes: used Ricotta cheese instead of cream cheese and I added a clove of fresh garlic with the cheese. I have had some trouble finding organic frozen spinach (I find organic spinach tastes better than non organic), so I've bought fresh organic spinach and sautéed it in olive oil and garlic to prep it for the recipe. It is a little extra work, but so yummy! Either way, this is an excellent recipe! I served it at a dinner party and received several requests for the recipe. Thank you!!!

I was very surprised at how flavorful this turned out! I used fresh spinach, sautéed with garlic n' oil. Also I only used about 1/3 jar of the sauce instead of what it called calling for. It was SO GOOD!

Very , very good and simple!! Instead of using the 4 ounces of cream cheese , I used 1/2 cream cheese & 1/2 ricotta. I also sauteed some sliced mushrooms with minced garlic in a lil bit of olive oil & added that to the roll. Everyone enjoyed this easy & very yummy dish! Will b making this one very soon again!!

Great recipe. To make life easier you can buy the oven ready noodles and boil for a minute or two to make them pliable. Makes it so quick. I add roasted red pepper and it adds even more flavor! Husband LOVES it and it's great left over.
I made this recipe but first I sauteed fresh spinach, garlic and red peppers in a small amount of oil and seasoning then I continued to follow the recipe. It was very simple and flavorful!

I changed the stuffing cheese to ricotta cheese because I did not have any cream cheese. It was a great hit with husband, loved them so much he ate two right away. Next time I try it I will do half with cream cheese and half the ricotta cheese and see which one tastes better. We enjoy heavily spiced foods, so when I make it I add more vegetables and seasonings to the stuffing. I think almost any stuffing choice will work with this recipe. I buy fresh noodles and do not pre-cook them, I roll stuffing around noodles, cover with lots of sauce and bake.

I made the sauce for this recipe from scratch instead of buying the spaghetti sauce. It was a variation of Annabel Karmel's hidden vegetables pasta sauce. My kids unwittingly had red and yellow bell pepper, carrots, tomato, and spinach in a single meal (mwahahahaha) and this is the first recipe I ever made that all family members really really liked (I am generally a terrible cook so thank you so much for this recipe).

I made it this way and it good.
Then I changed it and it was 10X better.
I added fresh spinach (instead of frozen). I added Mild Italian Sausage (remove skin and cook first). I use Ricotta Cheese instead of cream cheese. 
Everyone loved the changes...so I keep making it my way.

This is outstanding! My husband does not like ricotta cheese, so the cream cheese was a great alternative for us. It was just so good and easy. I made two pans of these, one with spaghetti sauce and the other with garlic alfredo sauce. Both were delicious!
My kids and husband (and I) absolutely loves this! I added crumbled spicy sausage to give it some kick. The roll-up concept is so simple and delicious. I will definitely make this again.

I have made this many times! It's on our regular dinner rotation. I have followed the recipe exactly most of the time, and also deviated a couple times adding Hot Italian sausage. It's delicious both ways!
I have gotten raves with this recipe. !!!! It's just delicious, well balanced and not too heavy.
Tasty, easy, and perfect for leftovers on the go!

I made this for my 50th birthday dinner in New Orleans. It was a big hit amongst my friends and family! It was my first time making it and we were staying at an airBNB so I did not have all my kitchen utensil and very little counter space to work with, but somehow I managed! I was so very surprised when all 8 of my guests asked for seconds! I made this with corn on the cob and a nice wedge salad that they all also loved! I am not a lasagna lover but this was a delicious alternative to the norm. Definitely making again for our Sunday dinners!
I added in some cottage cheese and it was Amazing!
Remarkably easy, and I love it more than the standard lasagna. This is going to be welcome here quite often!! :)
Remarkably easy, and I love it more than the standard lasagna. This is going to be welcome here quite often!! :)
I mixed garlic powder and oregano into the cheese and spinach mixture as well as added some parmesan on the inside of the rollups.
This was delicious and a hit with everyone, even the toddler! I added ground chicken to the mixture (1/2 pound) which was great for flavor and protein. Would definitely make it this way again!
